unit.title: Grab and run v2: prepared for its LTX run

design.setPiece: A run toward the camera down a cobbled street with a bottle, and police behind.

lastFrame.shows: The same person runs toward the camera on a cobbled street with the bottle in one hand.

prompt: A low medium shot on a narrow cobbled street at golden hour. A man in his late twenties with short dark curls, a short beard and round tortoiseshell glasses, in a rust-orange corduroy bucket hat and a cream and burgundy windbreaker over a white tee, sprints toward the lens with an amber glass bottle gripped by the neck in his right hand. He runs hard and loose: his knees drive up, his heels kick back, his shoulders and head rock with each stride, both arms pump at his sides with loose fists, and the open windbreaker stays on his shoulders and swings with his arms. His mouth is open as he breathes fast. The camera tracks backward low ahead of him, keeping him large in the frame, and turns slightly with him as the street bends. Behind him two police officers in dark uniforms run after him, and a plain white patrol car with flashing blue lights stands far back across the street. Warm low sunlight rakes across the stone facades, natural motion blur on his legs and arms, film-grade color, crisp detail. Fast footsteps slap the cobbles, his breath is ragged, and sirens wail in the distance.
